dashboard.label: SOC L1 Triage Dashboard
dashboard.description: Portfolio overview for Windows and Sysmon telemetry. Panels show search results for triage and do not by themselves confirm malicious activity.

search.query: index=blue EventCode=4625 | stats count AS value
index=blue EventCode=4740 | stats count AS value

index=blue EventCode=4104 | eval Script=coalesce(ScriptBlockText,Message) | where match(Script,"(?i)FromBase64String|EncodedCommand|DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|ExecutionPolicy Bypass|WindowStyle Hidden") | stats count AS value

index=blue EventCode=3 | eval Source_IP=coalesce(SourceIp,SourceAddress) | eval Destination_IP=coalesce(DestinationIp,DestinationAddress) | eval Destination_Port=coalesce(DestinationPort,dest_port) | stats dc(Destination_Port) AS Unique_Ports by Source_IP Destination_IP | where Unique_Ports>=10 | stats count AS value

panel.title: Recent SOC Triage Events
panel.description: Selected event types for analyst review; rows are not verdicts.

search.query: index=blue (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=11) | eval Detection=case(EventCode=4625,"Failed Logon",EventCode=4720,"New Account",EventCode=4740,"Account Lockout",EventCode=4104,"PowerShell Script Block",EventCode=1,"Process Creation",EventCode=3,"Network Connection",EventCode=11,"File Creation",true(),"Other") | eval Account=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,User,user,"Not available") | table _time Detection host Account EventCode | sort 0 - _time | head 100

index=blue (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=11) | eval Category=case(EventCode=4625,"Authentication",EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740,"Account Changes",EventCode=4104,"PowerShell",EventCode=1 OR EventCode=11,"Process and File",EventCode=3,"Network",true(),"Other") | stats count AS Events by Category | sort 0 - Events
index=blue (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=1 OR EventCode=3 OR EventCode=11) | timechart span=15m count AS Events
